title: 真实MySQL user@host匹配：USER声明身份与CURRENT_USER有效账户分别核对
answer:
```python
def identity(connection):
    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        cursor.execute('SELECT USER(),CURRENT_USER()');declared,matched=cursor.fetchone()
    return {'declared_identity':declared,'matched_account':matched}
```

原题知识说明：
账户匹配同时考虑用户名和连接来源。相同用户名不同host可有不同认证和授权；SELECT USER(),CURRENT_USER()可对照连接声明身份与实际匹配账户。

title: 真实filesort与磁盘证据分离：执行JSON计划和小结果排序，记录merge增量
answer:
```python
import json

def observe_sort(connection):
    sql='SELECT id FROM sort_work ORDER BY ABS(v-7),id'
    def flag(value):
        if isinstance(value,dict):return value.get('using_filesort') is True or any(flag(item) for item in value.values())
        if isinstance(value,list):return any(flag(item) for item in value)
        return False
    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        cursor.execute("SHOW SESSION STATUS LIKE 'Sort_merge_passes'");before=int(cursor.fetchone()[1])
        cursor.execute('EXPLAIN FORMAT=JSON '+sql);plan=json.loads(cursor.fetchone()[0])
        cursor.execute(sql);ids=[row[0] for row in cursor.fetchall()]
        cursor.execute("SHOW SESSION STATUS LIKE 'Sort_merge_passes'");after=int(cursor.fetchone()[1])
    return {'ids':ids,'using_filesort':flag(plan),'merge_passes':after-before,'disk_io_proven_by_filesort':False}
```

原题知识说明：
不是，filesort是额外排序算法名称，数据足够小时可在内存完成。结合排序行数、缓冲与磁盘临时活动判断，优化排序输入或索引，避免仅因这个词就调大内存。

title: 真实MySQL TLS身份校验：加密成功之外，错误主机名和不信任CA必须失败
answer:
```python
import ssl,pymysql

def connect_verified(options,ca):
    context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(ca));context.check_hostname=True;context.verify_mode=ssl.CERT_REQUIRED
    return pymysql.connect(**options,ssl=context)
```

原题知识说明：
加密连接状态只证明使用TLS，身份验证还取决于CA信任和主机名校验模式。核对客户端配置，隔离测试错误主机名与不可信证书必须失败，避免仅看Ssl_cipher即宣称防中间人。

exercise.environment: 非root Linux，现有本地原生工具，自有短生命周期资源
exercise.operation: 实现connect_verified(options,ca)。用ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(ca))，必须check_hostname=True且verify_mode=CERT_REQUIRED；pymysql.connect(**options,ssl=context)返回实际连接，不修改options、不在失败时关闭校验或退明文。私有CA仅信任IP 127.0.0.1：正确IP/CA能连接查询且Ssl_cipher非空；localhost错误DNS身份和另一个CA必须证书验证失败。对照连接故意不查主机名仍可有Ssl_cipher，不能据加密状态声称已验证身份。
exercise.validation_scope: 实际MySQL8.4 TLS握手、临时独立CA和仅IP SAN证书；密钥只在自有容器临时目录，不能作为生产CA/证书轮换验收，不更改宿主信任库、默认账户或外部服务。

"""Ephemeral private CA/server certificate, never persisted outside owned native scratch."""
import datetime,ipaddress,os
from cryptography import x509
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import hashes,serialization
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric import rsa
from cryptography.x509.oid import NameOID,ExtendedKeyUsageOID

def create_certificates(root):
 now=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc);key=rsa.generate_private_key(public_exponent=65537,key_size=2048)
 name=x509.Name([x509.NameAttribute(NameOID.COMMON_NAME,'OpsForge private test CA')])
 ca=x509.CertificateBuilder().subject_name(name).issuer_name(name).public_key(key.public_key()).serial_number(x509.random_serial_number()).not_valid_before(now-datetime.timedelta(days=1)).not_valid_after(now+datetime.timedelta(days=2)).add_extension(x509.BasicConstraints(ca=True,path_length=0),critical=True).sign(key,hashes.SHA256())
 server_key=rsa.generate_private_key(public_exponent=65537,key_size=2048)
 server=x509.CertificateBuilder().subject_name(x509.Name([x509.NameAttribute(NameOID.COMMON_NAME,'private-mysql')])).issuer_name(name).public_key(server_key.public_key()).serial_number(x509.random_serial_number()).not_valid_before(now-datetime.timedelta(days=1)).not_valid_after(now+datetime.timedelta(days=1)).add_extension(x509.BasicConstraints(ca=False,path_length=None),critical=True).add_extension(x509.SubjectAlternativeName([x509.IPAddress(ipaddress.ip_address('127.0.0.1'))]),critical=False).add_extension(x509.ExtendedKeyUsage([ExtendedKeyUsageOID.SERVER_AUTH]),critical=False).sign(key,hashes.SHA256())
 other_key=rsa.generate_private_key(public_exponent=65537,key_size=2048);other_name=x509.Name([x509.NameAttribute(NameOID.COMMON_NAME,'Untrusted test CA')])
 other=x509.CertificateBuilder().subject_name(other_name).issuer_name(other_name).public_key(other_key.public_key()).serial_number(x509.random_serial_number()).not_valid_before(now-datetime.timedelta(days=1)).not_valid_after(now+datetime.timedelta(days=1)).add_extension(x509.BasicConstraints(ca=True,path_length=0),critical=True).sign(other_key,hashes.SHA256())
 for filename,value in [('ca.pem',ca.public_bytes(serialization.Encoding.PEM)),('server.pem',server.public_bytes(serialization.Encoding.PEM)),('wrong-ca.pem',other.public_bytes(serialization.Encoding.PEM)),('server-key.pem',server_key.private_bytes(serialization.Encoding.PEM,serialization.PrivateFormat.TraditionalOpenSSL,serialization.NoEncryption()))]:
  path=root/filename;path.write_bytes(value);os.chmod(path,0o600)
